You press against the wound and keep your voice steady, giving your friend something to hold on to.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent Dying player character
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Universal

Stabilize at 0 HP and clear death marks. No roll. This grants no HP, removes no wound, and does not restore Grit. Taking damage while stable enters Dying again.
